senses.gloss: Resh, name of the twentieth letter of the alphabet.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 103b:13">Ib. 103ᵇ</cite> <he>דלתין ר׳ ר׳ דלתין</he> one must not write Daleths so as to look like Reshes, or Reshes so as to look like Daleths.—[<he>ריש לקיש</he>, v. <cite ref="L00694"><he>לָקִישׁ</he> I</cite>.]
